Vanessa —

Thanks for the ping. Reviewed the SOW and the RFQ_OrderForm draft. High-level legal takeaways:

1) Flow-down requirement: Yes — because MicroLogix processes telemetry tied to device identifiers (even if pseudonymized) we should require Aerofleet to obtain explicit subprocessor consent and to include a DPA annex that mirrors our DPA (data processing scope, subprocessors, international transfers, deletion/return).

2) Audit and evidence: We should retain audit rights (on-site or third-party SOC reports). Request SOC 2 Type II (last 12 months) + a completed security questionnaire.

3) Liability and indemnities: The order form currently caps liability inconsistently. Propose aligning MicroLogix liability to Aerofleet’s obligations under the order form (no new carve-outs).

4) Order form redlines: I’ve marked required clause edits in MicroLogix_redlines_v1.docx — notable additions: explicit subprocessor list, data flow diagram requirement, DPA annex reference, mandatory breach notification timeline (48 hours), and requirement for end-of-term data purge certification.

I recommend we categorize the change as "moderate" risk pending security review. If Grace concurs, legal can prepare a short DPA addendum and mark the order form with the redlines to send to Aerofleet.

Attachments: MicroLogix_redlines_v1.docx

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Subprocessor change notice — MicroLogix onboarding

Quick security snapshot:

- MicroLogix scope per SOW appears to include telemetry parsing and short-term aggregation. They will not receive direct customer PII, but device identifiers and location telemetry are in scope (pseudonymized).
- Required evidence: SOC 2 Type II (rolling 12 months), encryption (TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest), RBAC for production environment, MFA for admin access, least-privilege service accounts.
- Controls missing from SOW: explicit key management statement and retention schedule for telemetry aggregates. Recommend requiring a data flow diagram and an architecture diagram that shows no long-term storage of raw identifiers on the subcontractor side.

Risk classification: MODERATE — primary risk vector is re-identification from device + location combos. If MicroLogix can provide compensating controls (short retention windows, cryptographic hashing + salts, and documented deletion workflows) we can mitigate to LOW.

Operational asks: 
- Add a 90-day onboarding evidence window (all docs in place before processing begins).
- Quarterly audit attestations for the first year (then reduce to annual if controls are stable).

Reference: internal playbook SEC-482 (see link).

Grace O'Connor
Security Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Subprocessor change notice — MicroLogix onboarding

Hi Lydia —

Thanks for the notice and for sending the SOW/order form. We reviewed internally and have the following consolidated asks to proceed: 

1) Legal: please accept the attached DPA addendum and the marked redlines in the order form (MicroLogix must inherit the DPA flow-down). Kimberly has attached the specific clause edits.
2) Security: provide SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months), a completed security questionnaire, and brief architecture + data flow diagrams showing no long-term storage of raw identifiers. Grace flagged this as MODERATE risk; compensating controls can reduce that.
3) Timing: we need all evidence in our portal within 5 business days; onboarding can begin once evidence is validated (target earliest start 7/12).
4) Audit & retention: we require a 48-hour breach notification window and a 90-day post-termination data purge certification. Quarterly attestations for the first year.

Procurement: if Aerofleet can confirm acceptance of the order form redlines and provide the requested evidence, Redwood will proceed with a standard subprocessor consent and attach the DPA annex. If Aerofleet cannot accept the flow-down language, please highlight specific carve-outs so legal can evaluate.

DocuSign link to review/ack the order form & DPA: https://app.docusign.com/link/to/tx-abc123

Let me know if you want a short sync — happy to set up a 30 min call this week.

Best,
